summary.text: Annette Cleveland is a Washington state senator for the 49th Legislative District, first elected to the Senate in 2012. Her official biography says she chairs the Health & Long-Term Care Committee and serves as Caucus Vice Chair.

paragraphs.text: Cleveland was born and raised in the 49th Legislative District, according to her official biography.
The page describes her as an advocate for education, small business, affordable health care, and senior and veterans affairs.
It says she was serving her third term as state senator after first winning election to the Senate in 2012.

Her official biography says she has more than 30 years of public and private sector experience, including service on the Association of Washington Business Board of Directors, the Washington State Hospital Association's Public Policy Advisory Group and the Greater Vancouver Chamber of Commerce's Public Policy Advisory Committee.
It says she was most recently associated with a non-profit health system and has also worked with the Greater Vancouver Chamber of Commerce and at C-TRAN, the Clark County public transit system.
The page lists access to housing, quality education, affordable health care and family-wage jobs as her priorities, and says she lives in Vancouver with her husband and daughter.
